With the Tenno Sho (Autumn) drawing near, 
Maruzensky threw herself into rigorous 
training.

A few days later, a press conference was 
held for the racers entering the upcoming 
race, but—

Among those contenders stood Special 
Week—who, until now, had only ever watched 
Maruzensky's back from afar.

The long-awaited chance to face her 
arrived on the greatest stage possible... 
and Maruzensky smiled, unable to hide her 
overflowing joy.
